issue.summary: Same supplier on 3 different payment terms across ERPs

plan.diagnosis: Chennai Precision Components has USD 11,292,326 in annual spend fragmented across 4 ERPs (NetSuite, SAP_B, Oracle EBS, SAP_A) with 3 conflicting payment terms (NET 45, NT60, Net 30). This misalignment creates supplier confusion, potential early-payment leakage, and prevents leverage of working capital optimization across the enterprise.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct cross-ERP payment term audit to quantify actual days paid by ERP instance and calculate current weighted average DPO for Chennai Precision Components across all 4 systems
Negotiate single standardized payment term (target Net 60) with Chennai Precision Components covering all USD 11,292,326 spend, securing supplier agreement in writing with effective date

Update supplier master records in all 4 ERPs: SAP_A and SAP_B (vendor master table LFB1 payment terms field), Oracle EBS (supplier sites payment terms), NetSuite (vendor record payment terms), and Coupa (supplier information)
Implement AP system validation rules to flag any new invoices from Chennai Precision Components with non-standard terms and route for approval override
Execute supplier communication plan confirming unified Net 60 terms and establish single point of contact for payment inquiries across all business units

plan.expected_impact: Standardizing to Net 60 across USD 11,292,326 spend will yield approximately USD 46,000 annual working capital benefit assuming 5-day DPO improvement and 5% cost of capital.
kpis: Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) for Chennai Precision Components across all ERPs
Number of payment term exception requests
Weighted average cost of capital improvement (basis points)
risks: Supplier may resist Net 60 extension from Net 30 baseline without pricing concessions
ERP master data synchronization delays could perpetuate term mismatches during transition
Decentralized AP teams may continue legacy terms if not properly trained on new standard
Early payment discount opportunities (if currently available on Net 30 terms) may be forfeited
erp_actions: SAP_A and SAP_B: Update vendor master payment terms to Z060 (Net 60) in LFB1 table for all company codes associated with Chennai Precision Components
Oracle EBS: Modify supplier site payment terms to 'NET 60' for Chennai Precision Components across all operating units
NetSuite: Change vendor record payment terms field to 'Net 60' for Chennai Precision Components
Coupa: Update supplier information form payment terms to 'Net 60' and sync to downstream ERPs
All ERPs: Add data validation rule to invoice entry workflows requiring AP approval for any Chennai Precision Components invoice with terms other than Net 60
SAP_A and SAP_B: Create vendor master change audit report (table CDHDR/CDPOS) to track payment term modifications
